Question_Text: Does your organization maintain an active ISO 27001 certification or SOC 2 Type II report?
Is Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) strictly enforced for all employee and admin logins?
Acceptable_Evidence: Admin console screenshot or policy excerpt

Question_Text: Is customer data encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2+ and at rest using AES-256?
Are external penetration tests conducted at least annually by an independent third party?
Acceptable_Evidence: Executive summary of latest pentest report

Question_Text: Do you guarantee customer notification of security breaches within 48 hours?
Do you maintain a publicly accessible, up-to-date list of sub-processors?
Are backups replicated to a secondary geographical region and tested at least quarterly?
Are criminal background checks performed on all personnel with system access?
Can customer data be completely purged upon contract termination with formal certification?
Is customer data excluded from training public machine learning models without express consent?
Acceptable_Evidence: AI governance policy or customer agreement clause
